questions.prompt: Execution Policy is set to Restricted. Is it a security boundary?

options.a: No — a speed bump with documented, built-in bypasses
options.b: Yes — a strict security boundary that prevents unauthorized execution
options.c: Yes — it operates at the OS kernel level

questions.prompt: AMSI (Antimalware Scan Interface) — security control or speed bump?

options.a: Just a speed bump with no security value
options.b: A real security control — a genuine scan surface and telemetry source

questions.prompt: Constrained Language Mode (CLM) enforced by WDAC/AppLocker — control or speed bump?

options.a: A speed bump that can be turned off with an environment variable
options.b: A real security control that restricts .NET type access and COM creation
